title: BEC is a member-owned cooperative whose owners include Nykredit and Arbejdernes Landsbank
content:
BEC Financial Technologies is a member-owned cooperative whose owners include Nykredit and Arbejdernes Landsbank. The ownership structure is the claim: the customers and the shareholders are the same Danish banks.

That changes what a technology decision is. In a normal vendor relationship a supplier persuades a buyer; in a cooperative the buyers collectively own the supplier, so adopting something new is a decision the owner-banks take about their own shared infrastructure. It is slower and harder to reach from outside, and it also means a decision, once taken, lands across every member at once.

Nothing about its stack or open-source posture was researched, so the lead is qualified on structure alone and sits at priority 4 pending that screen. It is one of several Danish cooperatives in this set, and the recurrence of the structure is itself the pattern worth noting.
